description: Multi-field contact form. 'centered' layout works for standalone contact pages. 'split' layout pairs the form with contact details (email, phone, address) on the left — better for B2B sites where users want context before reaching out. Set action to a Formspree/Web3Forms/Netlify URL since the form is static.

description.hint: 1 sentence framing what happens after submit.

action.hint: Form action URL. Empty string posts to current page (won't work without backend). Use Formspree / Web3Forms / Netlify Forms for static sites.

fields.hint: Each field: { name, label, type (text/email/tel/url/textarea/select), placeholder?, required?, options? (select only), fullWidth? (forces full-row), rows? (textarea only). Common pattern: [name, email, subject, message].

successUrl.hint: Redirect after submit (forwarded as _next field — Formspree/Web3Forms convention).

splitContent.hint: Used only when layout='split'. items render as dt/dd pairs (e.g. Email/hi@..., Office/123 Main St).

preview.title: Tell us about your project.
preview.description: We typically reply within a business day.
